Part B 词汇：Easter, Chinese New Year, Christmas, birthday, date
Part A Let's talk：When is Easter? It's in April. 月份问答
Part B Let's talk：When is your birthday? My birthday is in May.
Let's spell：辅音连缀 dr / tr（draw, dress? 与 tree, travel）
中外重要节日的日期与习俗对比

modules.title: Unit 4 When Is the Art Show?（画展什么时候举行）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：序数词 first-tenth 与日期
Part B 词汇：eleventh-twentieth, special, fun, show, contest
Part A Let's talk：When is the art show? It's on April 20th.
Part B Let's talk：What will you do for... ? 活动日程表达
Let's spell：辅音连缀 fl / pl（fly, floor 与 plant, play）
校园活动日历与中外学校展览比赛

modules.title: Unit 5 Whose Dog Is It?（这是谁的狗）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：mine, yours, his, hers 名词性物主代词
Part B 词汇：dog, cat, rabbit? 与 whose, owner, love, adopt
Part A Let's talk：Whose dog is it? It's theirs. Is this yours?
Part B Let's talk：They're playing! Look after... 照看宠物表达
Let's spell：辅音连缀 pr / gr / cr（present, green, cry? cross）
失物招领与领养代替购买的爱护动物观念

modules.title: Unit 6 Work Quickly!（赶快干活）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：climbing, eating, playing, shopping, sleeping（现在分词）
Part B 词汇：fighting, swinging, running, quickly, slowly
Part A Let's talk：What is he doing? He's sleeping. Are they... ?
Part B Let's talk：What are the monkeys doing? They're fighting. Work quickly!
Let's spell：辅音连缀综合复习与词内拆分（spring, freeze）
劳动与家务参与：中外孩子的暑期计划

modules.title: Unit 1 How Can I Get There?（怎样到那儿）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：left, right, straight, across? 与 turn
Part B 词汇：science museum, bookstore, cinema, hospital, post office
Part A Let's talk：How can I get there? Turn left at the...
Part B Let's talk：Where is the... ? It's near/next to... Excuse me
Let's spell：字母组合 au / aw（autumn, audience? 与 saw, draw）
问路指路礼貌用语与中英街道路标差异

modules.title: Unit 2 Ways to Go to School（上学方式）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：by bus/plane/taxi/ship/subway, on foot
Part B 词汇：slow down, stop, traffic, lights, rules, helmet
Part A Let's talk：How do you come to school? I often go by bike.
Part B Let's talk：You must stop at a red light. Don't... 交通规则
Let's spell：字母组合 al / ll（walk, ball, small, tall）
世界各地孩子上学方式（雪橇、渡船、地铁）

modules.title: Unit 3 My Weekend Plan（我的周末计划）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：tonight, tomorrow, next week, dictionary, comic book
Part B 词汇：take a trip, visit my grandparents, see a film, post office, word
Part A Let's talk：What are you going to do tomorrow? I'm going to...
Part B Let's talk：Where are we going? When is... ? be going to 计划
Let's spell：字母组合 oi / oy（oil, boil, boy, toy）
中外家庭周末活动与计划制定习惯

modules.title: Unit 4 I Have a Pen Pal（我有一位笔友）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：hobby, read... stories? playing football, going hiking, pen pal
Part B 词汇：live, does, teaches? country, study, cooking? reading
Part A Let's talk：Does he like doing word puzzles? Yes, he does.
Part B Let's talk：What are his hobbies? He likes... 三单询问
Let's spell：字母组合 ear / er（hear, near, year 与 her?）
笔友文化与世界各国孩子的兴趣爱好

modules.title: Unit 5 What Does He Do?（他做什么工作）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：factory worker, postman, businessman, police officer
Part B 词汇：fisherman, scientist, pilot, coach? , work, sea, study
Part A Let's talk：What does your mother do? She's a scientist.
Part B Let's talk：Where does he work? How does he go to work? 职业问答
Let's spell：字母组合 air / are（air, careful 与 care, share?）
职业理想与劳动平等观（各行各业都重要）

modules.title: Unit 6 How Do You Feel?（你感觉怎样）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：angry, afraid, sad, worried, happy
Part B 词汇：see a doctor? wear a seat belt, take a deep breath, count to ten
Part A Let's talk：What's wrong? He is ill. How does he feel?
Part B Let's talk：You should see a doctor. Don't worry. 建议表达
Let's spell：元音组合综合复习（au/oi/ear/air 听辨拼写）
情绪管理与关心他人的中外表达

modules.title: Unit 1 How Tall Are You?（你多高）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：taller, shorter, older, younger 比较级
Part B 词汇：bigger, smaller, heavier, thinner, metres, dinosaur
Part A Let's talk：How tall are you? I'm 1.6 metres. You're taller than...
Part B Let's talk：Your dinosaur is bigger than mine. 比较句运用
语音技巧：句子重音与连贯朗读（比较句节奏）
中外年龄身高话题的礼貌边界（避免问体重年龄）

modules.title: Unit 2 Last Weekend（上周末）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：cleaned my room, washed my clothes, stayed at home
Part B 词汇：watched TV, read a book, had a cold, slept, late
Part A Let's talk：What did you do last weekend? I stayed at home.
Part B Let's talk：Did you do... ? Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 一般过去疑问
语音技巧：动词过去式 -ed 的三种读音 /t/ /d/ /ɪd/
中外家庭周末活动与家务分担

modules.title: Unit 3 Where Did You Go?（你去了哪里）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：went to Turpan? saw grapes? rode a horse, ate fresh food
Part B 词汇：took pictures, bought gifts? hurt, fell, holiday, camping
Part A Let's talk：Where did you go over the winter holiday? I went to...
Part B Let's talk：How was your holiday? It was... What did you do there?
语音技巧：陈述句降调与特殊疑问句语调
中国名胜与旅行文化（吐鲁番、长城）及中外假期

modules.title: Unit 4 Then and Now（从前与现在）

leaves.title: Part A 词汇：before, now, then, grass? dining hall, library 变化场所
Part B 词汇：cycling? ice-skating, badminton? 与 was, were, there was/there were
Part A Let's talk：Before, I... Now, I... 过去与现在对比
Part B Let's talk：There was... There are now... 描述变化
语音总复习：小学阶段字母组合音系小结（音系图）
生活环境的变迁与珍惜当下、小升初衔接
